title: Adding a collection with variants — Special Skis
_note: BCP admin recipe special-skis. Cut from ski-demo_special-skis_dev_10-19-12_v12.mp4 (375.88s). The screens were MEASURED off that capture — the totals agree with its own length to a tenth of a second — so every line here was written to a screen that already exists and nothing needs stretching. ⚠ THE REPEATED ITEMS ARE SILENT ON PURPOSE. Carson, 2026-09-10: "add the voice for every scene, except for the the items, since they are all repeats of the same first item." The first item is narrated in full and its closing line tells the viewer what the silent stretch is before they watch it; the clones are one scene with no cue, as long as the footage it covers, so every later line stays on its own screen. That is a deliberate exception to standard 1 of the raw-video standard, not an omission. Lines carry {0.3} beat markers; a marker is never counted as a word and its silence is always added to the scene.

scenes.label: sign-in
scenes.line: Please provide us your email, so we can sent you a login code. Then click the Send Code button.

scenes.label: enter-the-code
scenes.line: We will send you a four-digit code to that address. {.8} If you are not seeing it, please check your spam folder.

scenes.label: dashboard
scenes.line: This is your admin dashboard. {0.5} Open a Business with the store you want to work on.

scenes.label: find-the-business
scenes.line: Start typing your business name, {0.3} then select it from the dropdown list.

scenes.label: the-business
scenes.line: When your business page opens. {0.5} Choose Lookup Stores to see all the stores of this business.

scenes.label: find-the-store
scenes.line: Start typing the name of the store you are looking for, {0.3} and select it from the dropdown list. {0.5} All activities after this will act against this store alone.

scenes.label: the-store
scenes.line: This is the store page. {0.5} Click on the gear icon in the menu and choose Lookup Collections.

scenes.label: collection-list
scenes.line: Here you can find all the store's collections, if needed. {0.5} Press the plus icon button to add a new collection.

scenes.label: new-collection
scenes.line: Give the collection a unique name. {0.5} A collection is a group of items that can differ just by their options, or could be some like or similar items.

scenes.label: collection-details
scenes.line: Add a description to guide your renters. {4} Then set the starting price, in cents only, meaning no decimal point.

scenes.label: collection-options
scenes.line: Options are what makes one item different from another. {0.8} The label is what renter will see. {0.5} The name is the system key the item is saved under, and used for an item match. {0.8} The type can bool, string or a number. {0.5} The required option means this item is needed to complete the order and should always be true. {0.5} The values are the list of selections the dropdown will offer.

scenes.label: the-collection
scenes.line: After the collection is saved. {0.5} We can create an item from every one of these variants.

scenes.label: back-to-the-store
scenes.line: Now, lets return to the collections page. {2} Then we can return to the store page. {2} Open the menu again using the gear icon. {1} Then choose Lookup Items.

scenes.label: item-list
scenes.line: This is where all the store's items can be found. {0.5} To add a new item, click the plus icon button.

scenes.label: new-item
scenes.line: Give the item a name with the variants added. The renter can see by the item name that they are getting the item options they want. {0.5} Then search and select the collection this item belongs to. {1.5} Use the Create button to save it.

scenes.label: item-details
scenes.line: Build out the item here, in the details page. {2} Add an Item description, {2} Confirm you are in the right collection. {2} Then add how many of this specific item you have for rent. {2} Then add the price in cents. {2} The requirement is the set of questions a renter answers for the equipment items they are renting from you. {2} The attributes may hold some image details that will be automatically added, so you can skip over this.

scenes.label: item-detail-variants
scenes.line: Finally add the specific options for this item by selecting the option variant from the dropdown list. {2} Choose the brand variant, {2} and a length variant. {2} The star after the option name indicates that you made these a required field, which means the renter needs to make a variant selection. {2} Then Press Update to save it.

scenes.label: first-variant
scenes.line: That is the first variant saved. {0.5} Every other one is a copy of it with just one dropdown changed.

scenes.label: the-other-variants
scenes._silent_note: No line, on purpose — these screens repeat the first item. The scene is as long as its footage so later cues stay on the right picture. Trim or speed this stretch in the edit.

scenes.label: last-variant
scenes.line: All nine variants now exist in the collection — three brands, each in three lengths.

scenes.label: sign-out
scenes.line: Back at the dashboard when you are done. {0.3} Logout is a card here, same as the rest.

scenes.label: signed-out
scenes.line: You are signed out. {0.5} Your collection and all nine of its variants are saved and ready to rent.
